source_facts: The Index is adjusted on the Rebalance Day after Close of Business.
The adjustment reflects the new selection of the Index Components determined on the Selection Day.
The selection is determined in accordance with Sections 2.1 and 2.2.
The adjustment is carried out by implementing the shares determined on the Fixing Day.
The shares are based on the weights calculated on the Selection Day.
Solactive will publish changes to the Index Components with sufficient notice before the Rebalance Day.
Solactive will publish the changes on the Solactive website under Announcement.
render_facts: An Ordinary Rebalance is carried out on a Rebalance Day.
On the Selection Day for that Rebalance Day, the new selection for the Index is determined in accordance with Sections 2.1 and 2.2.
The Ordinary Rebalance adjusts the Index after the close of business on that day and reflects the new selection.
It is implemented by shares determined on the Fixing Day, with those shares based on the weights calculated on the Selection Day.
Section 3.1 Index Component Changes relate to the Index and to an Index Component.
Solactive publishes a notice for each such change with sufficient notice, on the Solactive Website, under the Announcement Section, no later than the day before the relevant Rebalance Day.
